description: A React custom hook 'useCachedFetch' that manages data fetching with caching, TTL, and safe unmount handling. It provides a way to fetch data asynchronously, cache it using context, and refetch as needed while avoiding memory leaks.

methods.name: useCachedFetch({ key, fetcher, ttlMs = 30_000, deps = [], immediate = true, })
methods.description: A hook to fetch data with caching via AppStateContext's getCached/setCached, supporting TTL, refetch, and safe unmount behavior.
